verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes a per-resource API reference (Invoices, Expenses, Payments, Journal Entries, Reports, Errors) and a first-party Postman collection, which gives users runnable example requests. Nothing shows an in-browser interactive 'try it' console, and the runnable examples depend on importing the collection into Postman. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs API explorer, documented runnable code samples within the reference itself, any description of the Postman collection's contents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: with a Postman collection, a Tools and Libraries page, request-limits documentation
